description:
Get your child riding with confidence on the Torker BMX LP Balance Bike. This 12-inch pedal-free design teaches balance and coordination before transitioning to a full bike. Built with sealed bearing hubs, Alloy Rims, pneumatic tires, and a comfortable padded saddle, it delivers a genuine riding experience. The adjustable quick-release seatclamp adapts as your child grows.
Skip training wheels and watch your young rider master essential skills while building independence and a lifelong love of cycling. Choose Chrome with Gold Parts or Black with Copper Parts.
